ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio; approximately 60% high-intensity white/cream pixels concentrated in central lobe regions vs 40% low-intensity black pixels located along the perimeter and in radiating speckle patterns.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity central regions; dense low-intensity mottling radiating from the peduncle base; distinct circular low-intensity focal spot located in the mid-section of the left lobe; heavy low-intensity banding along the entirety of the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 38 degrees relative to the lobe midlines.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Right lobe exhibits high-frequency sawtooth serrations with consistent pixel amplitude; left lobe contains a large, irregular non-linear excision (missing tissue) approximately one-fifth of the distance from the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading to distal tips that taper and curve slightly anteriorly.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Massive, high-contrast, heterogeneous clusters of barnacle colonization (balanids) densely packed on the extreme distal tips of both lobes; left tip shows greater vertical thickness of colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple parallel, vertical low-intensity linear disruptions (rake marks) on the right inner lobe; singular vertical mark on the left inner lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major irregular traumatic indentation on the trailing edge of the left lobe; extensive parasitic/epibiotic colonization on both fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Single, well-defined circular black pigmentation spot isolated within the high-intensity white field of the left lobe.
